patterns.name: Two Pointer
patterns.blurb: Two fingers moving from opposite ends or same direction. Best for: sorted arrays, finding pairs. Each step eliminates candidates.
patterns.recognition: A sorted array with a request to find a pair or a particular condition.

patterns.name: Sliding Window
patterns.blurb: A window that widens and shrinks to keep a valid subset. Best for: substrings/subarrays, fixed or variable length.
patterns.recognition: A request for the longest or shortest subarray or substring that satisfies a condition.

patterns.name: Hash Map
patterns.blurb: Save what you have seen in a notebook. Best for: checking duplicates, finding partners. See once, find instantly.
patterns.recognition: A need to ask "has this value appeared before" repeatedly.

patterns.name: Binary Search
patterns.blurb: Discard half the search space each step. Best for: sorted arrays, finding one value. From 1000 numbers, just 10 steps.
patterns.recognition: Sorted data, or a monotonic answer space that can be tested at the middle.

patterns.name: Dynamic Programming
patterns.blurb: Count from small to large, save each answer. Best for: repeated choices, optimal substructure.
patterns.recognition: Overlapping repeated choices, where a large answer is built from smaller answers.
patterns.complexity: O(n) to O(n^2) time, O(n) space

patterns.name: BFS & DFS
patterns.blurb: Traverse layer by layer (BFS) or dive as deep as possible (DFS). Best for: grids/graphs, shortest path, connected components.
patterns.recognition: A grid, tree, or graph structure, with a request for shortest distance or exhaustive exploration.

patterns.name: Stack
patterns.blurb: Stack waits for a match. Best for: balanced brackets, next greater element, expression evaluation.
patterns.recognition: Matching open and close pairs, or a need for the next greater element.

patterns.name: Greedy & Interval
patterns.blurb: Take the best decision for the current step. Best for: intervals, scheduling, greedy is always optimal.
patterns.recognition: Overlapping time intervals or colliding schedules.
patterns.complexity: O(n log n) time, O(1) space
